This restores the freezer's own default for rights-unknown sources; the CC-licensed fixtures in manifest-cq13.json and manifest-raw-mode.json keep their thumbnails.

recipe.timestamps: frozen shot starts + 1 fps over the hook window

redactions.reason: Security and privacy sweep finding Z-H2. This fixture committed extracted frames of an identifiable named creator and a near-complete verbatim transcript of a short video, republished under this repository's MIT grant with no rights basis recorded. The content is removed; the measurements it supported are not.
redactions.policy: Commit measurements about the work and content hashes; never the work's own content. Same shape as handoff/research/ocr-calibration/ and handoff/research/filler-corpus-counts.json.

derived_frames.note: JPEG thumbnails deleted. Per-frame SHA-256 anchors are retained under derived_frames.sha256, so anyone holding the SHA-verified source media can regenerate the same frames with derived_frames.recipe and confirm they match the frames these measurements were taken from.

transcript_text.note: Every words[].text and captions[].text is now the empty string. Word and caption timings, per-item confidence, caption position, all_caps, and words_visible are unchanged, so every derived measurement in this fixture and in tools/eval/profiles/real-frozen/ still computes from committed data.
transcript_text.hash_definition: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the removed text values joined with a single newline, in array order. It anchors an independent re-measurement to the same transcript; it is not a means of recovering the text.
